notes.title: "Pretty Girls Escape" How to play!
notes.content:
[How to play]
The game is cleared when the character block(s) is moved to the exit.
Stage Mode
In this game mode, the game is cleared when the character block(s) reaches the bottom of the stage.
Challenge Mode
In this game mode, players must reach a specific position at the bottom of the screen to clear the stage.
It is more challenging than Stage Mode and tests your thinking ability.

[Rule]
1. At the beginning of the game, blocks are placed on the stage.
If there are blocks of the same color somewhere on the top, bottom, left, and right, you can erase the blocks by selecting them.
If the blocks disappear and there are blocks on top of the empty squares, the blocks will fall.
The more blocks you erase at once, the higher the score you can get.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406937/549bb5c1aec264c4adff4a359e62b73060590d1b.png

2. The blocks can be slid left or right.
When a slide is made, all blocks move in that direction.
After moving, if there is an empty space underneath, the blocks will fall.
You can use the slide as many times as you like.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406937/60dae8e39b3deb55dca555a870579b6aebe2cbb2.png

3. You can clear the stage by placing the character block(s) directly above the exit.
Points are awarded when a stage is cleared.
Each stage also has a mission, and additional points are earned for completing the mission and clearing the stage.
The points earned can be exchanged for costumes and backgrounds that can be used in the dressing room.
*Points can only be earned once for each stage when clearing a stage or completing a mission.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406937/b6e8f363072faed7f22aab8a740775c6977eaaab.png

About exits
The stage is cleared by placing the character block(s) adjacent to the two squares directly above the exit.
In some stages, the exit may be locked.
In such cases, the game will not be cleared even if the character block is adjacent to it.
To unlock the lock, place the key block adjacent to the top of the exit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406937/2c8ff84c0f93c426f1cd3c08a07fd8e7d27decb8.png

Block Types
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406937/cc2203dbd9415161c7e88b6cc1e54d5fa3be3d22.png
[olist]
Normal block
If there are blocks of the same color somewhere on the top, bottom, left, and right, you can erase them by selecting them.
Character block
The stage is cleared by placing this block adjacent to the top of the exit.
Black block
An obstructive block that cannot be erased. They move together when you slide the stage.
Wall block
A block that cannot be erased or moved by sliding.
Spike block
An troublesome block that cannot be erased. If it touches the character block(s), the game is over.
Key block
A block that can unlock a locked exit. It must be moved directly above the locked exit in order to unlock it.
Box block
An obstructive block that falls but cannot be moved by sliding. Each time an adjacent block disappears, the box block is damaged and can be broken after a certain amount of damage is inflicted.
Piston block
A block that cannot be erased or moved by sliding. Every time the STEP changes, the piston expands and contracts. The block cannot pass through the place where the piston is extended. Also, if there is a block when the piston extends, the block is pushed out.
[/olist]
